headline: Palace Orders Alternative Work Arrangements in NCR and 12 Provinces Amid Habagat Rains
seoTitle: Palace Orders Alternative Work Setup in NCR, 12 Provinces | FMB News
seoDescription: Malacañang directed executive offices in NCR and 12 Luzon provinces to use alternative work arrangements from noon August 17 amid heavy rains.
deck: The noon directive covered executive offices while essential frontline services were required to continue operations.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: Malacañang ordered government executive offices in Metro Manila and 12 Luzon provinces to shift to alternative work arrangements from noon Monday as heavy Habagat rains affected travel and flood conditions.
The covered provinces listed in the newsroom brief were Bulacan, Pampanga, Bataan, Zambales, Tarlac, Nueva Ecija, Pangasinan, Cavite, Laguna, Batangas, Rizal and Occidental Mindoro.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: Agencies responsible for health, disaster response, law enforcement, fire protection and other vital services were directed to maintain necessary operations.

sections.heading: Why this matters
paragraphs: The measure is intended to reduce exposure of government workers to hazardous travel conditions while keeping essential public services operating.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Watch for updated Palace, Civil Service Commission and local government advisories as weather conditions change.
